incident_text: A building is burning and firefighters are working on it.

result.scene_summary: A house is engulfed in flames and thick black smoke, with firefighters operating from a grassy slope below. Trees surround the structure.

observations.description: Large plume of thick, dark smoke rising from the building.
Bright orange flames visible through broken windows and on the side of the building.
Roof and walls appear damaged; some panels are missing or charred.
Three figures in firefighter gear visible on the slope, operating a hose.
No vehicles visible in the image.
A fence is visible in the lower-left portion of the image.
Green grass and trees surrounding the building.

not_determinable: Structural integrity of building beyond visible damage
